changes: Graph is renamed WGraph for weighted adjacency lists; Edge is still int to + int64_t w and uses the common graph guard.
Merge queue/validation/negative flags into one byte per vertex; remove a byte array and one allocation for large graphs.
Cache from-distance and path length during one row. An improving self-loop in a row with multiple edges immediately propagates negative influence.
When n*max_cost<INF, every finite candidate>-INF. Its ordinary distance comparison already rejects a destination marked -INF; omit a separate per-edge state load.
Test negative influence before dequeue-state assignment; normal vertices use a direct checked/zero state assignment.

Rows of exactly one edge avoid the edge iteration loop and the extra test for an intermediate self-loop update. FIFO order, path-length bound, exception output preservation with checks enabled, and O(V) extra space are maintained.

memory.notes: distance/path/state/queue array payload only; excludes vector/control objects and caller result. Negative propagation additionally reserves up to 4V bytes. No O(E) cache is adopted.

dijkstra.scope: Dijkstra small path; Graph -> WGraph alias change also applied
dijkstra.policy: Clang only uses packed uint64 heap keys at <=256 vertices. With |w|<=1e9 and w>=0, every candidate is <2^38; low 8 bits hold the vertex. The ordering equals pair(distance, vertex). GCC and other compilers keep the pair heap after regression screening. Large path is unchanged.

limits: 全条件で元版以上という結果ではない。内側だけの整数照会では積和保護の費用が残る。
2D native Clang SKIPの小規模混在maxは旧10.804427 /今回前11.768727 /現11.778136ms、1照会あたり旧版比+0.973709ns。
標準C++代替はnativeと別集計。2Dではキャッシュ無効と拡張inline制御なしの条件で元版との差が大きいものが残る。
add/clearも同じ1Dドライバーで測定。本文未変更でも呼出側のコード配置による差が残り、全操作一律の改善とは説明しない。
